exec(open(WORK/'builder.py').read())
M = np.load(WORK/'pass_4/attention_mask.npy').astype(bool)
para = np.repeat(np.arange(32)[:,None], M.shape[1], 1)[M]
te = para>=24
for Lr in [1,2]:
    pre=f"roberta.encoder.layer.{Lr}."
    W1 = base(pre+"intermediate.dense.weight"); b1 = base(pre+"intermediate.dense.bias"); W2 = base(pre+"output.dense.weight"); b2=base(pre+"output.dense.bias")
    A = ffn_data(Lr); H = gelu(A@W1.T+b1); R = A+H@W2.T+b2
    m=2048
    for ntr in [8,16,24]:
        tr = para<ntr
        Rv = R[te]-R[tr].mean(0)
        sc=H[tr].var(0)*(W2**2).sum(0); keep=np.argsort(-sc)[:m]; drop=np.setdiff1d(np.arange(3072),keep)
        Hk=H[:,keep]; T=H[:,drop]@W2[:,drop].T; mk=Hk[tr].mean(0); mt=T[tr].mean(0); Xk=Hk[tr]-mk; G=Xk.T@Xk
        res=[]
        for lr in [None,1.0]:
            B=np.zeros((m,768)) if lr is None else np.linalg.solve(G+lr*np.trace(G)/m*np.eye(m), Xk.T@(T[tr]-mt))
            D=T[te]-mt-(Hk[te]-mk)@B; res.append(np.linalg.norm(D)/np.linalg.norm(Rv))
        print(f"L{Lr} ntr_paras={ntr} tokens={tr.sum()} meancomp {res[0]:.3f} LS {res[1]:.3f}")
